proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. types.ts defines UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. The v4 taxonomy has magic_item_root but the surface schema has no corresponding record type.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_bundle
proposed_widenings.justification: Dragon Scale Mail's three passive benefits (+1 AC, Advantage on breath weapon saves, Resistance) are always-on while attuned and worn. No existing mechanics family models a set of always-on passive effects that activate on attunement rather than on an explicit action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class, you have Advantage on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons, and you have Resistance to one damage type

proposed_widenings.name: scoped_advantage_on_save
proposed_widenings.justification: The Advantage rider applies specifically to saving throws against dragon breath weapons. The existing modify_roll_advantage type accepts only a list of RollKind values (attack_roll, saving_throw) with no mechanism to filter by trigger context (creature type + ability source). A new variant of the advantage modifier type with a trigger filter is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons

proposed_widenings.name: discern_location
proposed_widenings.justification: The active ability (Magic action, once per dawn) outputs directional/distance information about the nearest creature of a specified type within a range. No v4 atom covers this. grant_sense covers perceptual senses (darkvision, truesight) but not divination-style location awareness outputting bearing + distance.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can focus your senses as a Magic action to discern the distance and direction to the closest dragon within 30 miles of yourself that is of the same type as the armor

proposed_widenings.name: dawn_reset
proposed_widenings.justification: The active use recharges at the next dawn. The existing RestResetCadence type covers short_rest, long_rest, short_or_long_rest, and partial_short_full_long. Dawn is a time-of-day event, not a rest event, and cannot be expressed by any existing reset cadence variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This action can't be used again until the next dawn.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord in types.ts has no magic_item kind. Even with a MagicItemRecord added, four further gaps remain: (1) no passive-bundle mechanics family for always-on worn/attuned effects, (2) no scoped advantage filter for trigger context (breath weapon of creature type), (3) no discern_location atom, (4) no dawn reset cadence. The attunement_slot resource atom exists in v4 taxonomy but is absent from types.ts, which is a fifth gap once the record type is added.
